verdict.rationale: Moosend's homepage makes only a generic first-party claim that users can connect their apps with zero coding. None of the specific stack pieces in the story is named, and the evidence does not show the integrations are first-party or maintained. Missing for 10: named Stripe or Shopify integrations, a Segment or other CDP integration, a product-database connector, evidence the integrations are first-party and maintained, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect the platform to my existing stack — Stripe or Shopify, a CDP like Segment, my product database — with maintained first-party integrations

citations.quote: Connect all your apps and get your job done without switching tabs. Zero coding required.
